newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast spot power flat in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast spot power flat in lackluster trade.

text.p: Physical wholesale electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. finished Monday flat versus Friday's values in lackluster activity, market source said.

"It was pretty dead," said a Houston trader, adding most marketers and Northeast utilities on Friday scheduled power through Tuesday ahead of the observance of the Columbus Day holiday in the U.S. and Thanksgiving day in Canada.
Little weather-related demand also dampened spot trading for Tuesday in the region, industry sources said.
"Load's slightly off," the Houston trader said.

The latest forecasts showed a cold snap would arrive in parts of the Northeast on Tuesday. Temperatures in northern regions of New York and New England were expected to bottom in mid-20's and low-30's Fahrenheit by late Tuesay.
A few participants suggested that the weather system could bolster the region's natural gas, and in turn, electricity prices Tuesday when normal trading levels resume.
The 910 megawatt (MW) Maine Yankee nuclear power plant in Wiscasset, Maine, was scheduled to restart this weekend after tripping off line during testing last Wednesday.
Maine Yankee Atomic Power Co officials could not be reached today for comment about the status of the generating station.

In the New England Power Pool (NEPOOL), peak, non-firm electricity for Tuesday delivered to Northeast Utilities' territory border was notationally assessed at $31.00-$32.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), flat from Friday's quote for Monday. Bids were heard as low as $29.00.
Off-peak, non-firm NEPOOL power for Tuesday was pegged at $21.00-$22.00, unchanged from Friday's quote.
In the New York Power Pool (NYPP), peak, non-firm power delivered in the western part of the grid for Tuesday was talked in the $19.00-$20.00 range, and off-peak, non-firm delivery near $14.00.
In eastern NYPP, peak, non-firm electricity for Tuesday was discussed in the $26.00-$27.00, flat from Friday's quoted for Monday power.
Off-peak, non-firm, eastern NYPP power for next-day delivery was again assessed at $15.50=$16.00.
